symptom: `$Guid = call java action CommunityCommons.getGUID(); change $Obj (Code = $Guid);` — a missing argument and an Integer result assigned to a String attribute — passed check and exec; mx check reported CE0115 and CE0117.
file: mdl/exprcheck/call_argument.go checkMemberKind (wired in parser.go); mdl/exprcheck/adapters WithCallResultKinds + flowScope.recordCallResults; mdl/executor/typecheck.go callResultKind; mdl/executor/validate.go missingCodeActionArgs. Tests: mdl/exprcheck/member_kind_2464_test.go, mdl/executor/code_action_missing_args_2464_test.go
cause: Three gaps: the expectations table resolves create/change members 'AttributeOf:Parent' but nothing compared value and attribute (even `Code = 5` passed); call results were never typed in the flow scope; and code-action calls were checked for unknown argument names but not for missing ones.
insight: **Measure which omissions the build rejects before refusing them.** A blanket 'every parameter needs an argument' rule looked right from the issue, but 11.12.6 with each kind left out showed only the entity-type parameter (ENTITY <pE>) is CE0115 — Integer, object, type-parameter object and Microflow build clean with no mapping — so the blanket rule would have refused valid scripts. The member matrix (13 microflows, 7 CE0117) matched the #2096 call-argument predicate exactly, so it is reused rather than re-derived.
